name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Stand beneath the Smith bar behind your head and take a wide overhand grip that keeps your forearms vertical.
Set your feet firmly, brace your trunk and release the hooks only within your comfortable shoulder range.
Press the bar smoothly straight overhead until your arms are extended without forcefully locking your elbows.
Lower the bar behind your head only as far as you can without moving your neck forward.
tips: Stop lowering around ear level if going deeper strains your shoulders or forces your head far forward.
Keep your rib cage down and avoid overarching your lower back as you press.
